title: Session-startup ToolSearch for start_spec/start_run schema not addressed by schema preload
description: The schema preload spec (moeb.start-commands-tool-schema-preload) eliminates ToolSearch calls made after start_spec/start_run returns. However, the orchestrating agent must still call ToolSearch to load start_spec/start_run own schemas before invoking them. This session-startup ToolSearch continues to fail moeb-tool-origin on every run, meaning one external tool call remains even after the schema preload spec is fully implemented.
proposed_resolution: Investigate whether the moeb MCP server can keep start_spec and start_run schema payloads small enough that Claude Code does not defer them. Alternatively, document this as a known per-session overhead in fix_signal.skill.md and update the moeb-tool-origin rubric guidance to acknowledge it as a gated exception until a server-side solution is found.
